statements.statement: The procedure code billed was CPT 93229
The denial reason code was CO-197
The denial was because required prior authorization was missing
The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations and lightheadedness
The clinical indication note raises concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia and other unspecified cardiac arrhythmias
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
The note indicates prolonged ambulatory monitoring to detect intermittent rhythm disturbances that may contribute to cerebrovascular risk
